2122615740368822365.en_summary: Safe Havens in Health and Consumer Products: $PFE, $PEP and $HRL. Pfizer (PFE): Oncology bet with ~39% growth in cancer treatments via Seagen acquisition, ~5.9% yield, healthy payout ratio ~57%. PepsiCo (PEP): 54-year Dividend King owning Lay's, Doritos, Gatorade, Quaker; forward P/E 16-17, yield 4.0-4.2% despite packaged food concerns. Hormel Foods (HRL): 98 years continuous dividends, 60 years increases; 47% controlled by The Hormel Foundation focusing on long-term dividend safety, yield over 5.2% historically attractive.
2122615740368822365.zh_summary: 健康和消費品中的安全避風港：$PFE、$PEP 和 $HRL。輝瑞（PFE）：透過Seagen收購在癌症治療中約39%增長的腫瘤學押注，約5.9%收益率，健康派息率約57%。百事（PEP）：54年股息王，擁有Lay's、Doritos、Gatorade、Quaker；前瞻市盈率16-17，收益率4.0-4.2%，儘管包裝食品擔憂。荷美爾食品（HRL）：連續98年股息，60年增加；47%由The Hormel Foundation控制，專注長期股息安全，收益率超過5.2%歷史上具吸引力。
